technology_name: HIGH-EFFICIENCY FIELD-ORIENTED CONTROL SYSTEM WITH ASYMMETRICAL CASCADED H-BRIDGE MULTILEVEL INVERTER FOR ENHANCED PMSM PERFORMANCE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Electric Motor Drives / Vector Control System
problem_solved: Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSMs) experience high torque ripples and voltage stresses when driven by basic multi-level structures without real-time tracking.
description: An advanced Field-Oriented Control (FOC) system engineered around an asymmetrical cascaded H-bridge multi-level inverter setup, integrated with bidirectional DC-DC converters, current sensors, a speed encoder, and proportional-integral (PI) regulators.
applications: Electric vehicle traction powertrains, industrial robotic joint motors, high-speed automated assembly drives, and precision CNC servo systems.
